name: RoomNo.404
source:
"Room 404" is a visual novel set in the backdrop of urban life.

Wei Chiyu, a college student on her internship, moves into a cheap, run-down apartment complex. But soon, she finds herself caught in a series of supernatural events.
She ends up sharing her body with a ghost, and in two weeks, both of them will vanish into thin air—bound together by fate, where will these two girls end up?

Learn about Wei Chiyu and the people around her. Piece together everyone’s experiences to uncover the full story.
As the story progresses, search for a way to escape this peril and reach different endings.

To understand the lives of passing strangers in a fleeting moment might be wishful thinking, but maybe this encounter won’t be in vain.
Misunderstand each other, warm each other’s hearts, and continue walking alongside these chance-met companions—or, perhaps, part ways with a smile.

The young people born at the turn of the century will share this memory with you. 

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2446080/404/]steam[/url]]
translation:
《404房间》是一部以都市生活为背景的视觉小说。

正在实习的大学生魏驰玉搬进了一座廉价破旧的公寓楼。但很快，她发现自己陷入了一系列灵异事件。
她最终与鬼魂共生，两周后，两人便烟消云散——命运相连，这两个女孩的结局又将何去何从？

了解卫驰宇和她身边的人。将每个人的经历拼凑起来，揭开完整的故事。
随着故事的进展，寻找摆脱危险的方法并达到不同的结局。

在转瞬即逝的瞬间了解路过的陌生人的生活也许是一厢情愿，但也许这次邂逅不会白费。
互相误解，温暖彼此的心，继续与这些偶遇的伙伴并肩前行——或者，也许微笑着分道扬镳。

世纪之交出生的年轻人将与你分享这段记忆。

[译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2446080/404/]steam[/url]]
